headline: KP Aviation Industry posts H1 net loss of KRW 11.9 billion, reflecting KRW 13.9 billion in merger costs
summary: KP Aviation Industry, an aircraft structures and defense parts maker, recorded a first-half net loss of KRW 11.9 billion. The loss reflects about KRW 13.9 billion in non-cash merger costs from its KOSDAQ listing via SPAC merger, while core operations posted an operating profit.
why: KOSDAQ is South Korea's technology-focused exchange, and SPAC mergers are a route for private companies to list publicly.
